VIRO-0010.title: Autosave large-document quota and write-failure hardening
VIRO-0010.outcome: Autosave on a large document (many embedded images) can never lose the last good recovery snapshot: quota or write failures are handled explicitly, any user-visible status stays truthful, and the per-tick cost of autosave is measured and reduced (eliminating the double full-document deep-clone per tick) without changing the document schema or recovery file format in a way that breaks existing recovered sessions.

VIRO-0011.title: Document-identity recovery model replacing the single recovery slot
VIRO-0011.outcome: Crash recovery is keyed by document identity: working in document B never destroys the recovery snapshot of document A, recovery restore preserves project identity, and the recovery picker (if any) only ever offers snapshots that still exist in the store.

VIRO-0012.title: 60-FPS interaction profiling harness with one verified bottleneck fix
VIRO-0012.outcome: A repeatable, checked-in measurement harness produces real frame-time numbers for common canvas interactions (move, resize, marquee, pan, zoom, and a many-layer document with layer effects), identifies the actual bottleneck from data, and delivers at most one minimal, visually-identical compositor fix for a proven bottleneck (candidate: unbounded shadow saveLayer region) — or documents with measurements that no fix is justified yet.

VIRO-0013.title: Import parser fuzz and negative-input test corpus for PSD/VDJ/PressJSON
VIRO-0013.outcome: The PSD, VDJ and Press JSON import paths survive arbitrary malformed input without uncaught crashes outside their documented error handling: a checked-in fuzz/negative corpus plus a deterministic runner proves typed, user-safe failure for truncated, oversized, deeply-nested, wrong-mime and hostile-declaration inputs, and any proven parser defect found is fixed with the smallest safe change.

VIRO-0014.title: Font/image/import sanitization regression hardening
VIRO-0014.outcome: User-uploaded fonts and images are validated before entering the library or the renderer: the font registry and image sniffing paths reject hostile or malformed inputs with typed errors, proven by a regression suite, with no change to valid-file behavior.

VIRO-0015.title: PNG/PDF export regression corpus and fidelity report expansion
VIRO-0015.outcome: A versioned export regression corpus (documents plus expected PDF operator topology and PNG pixel checksums) is checked in and runnable, so compound-path behavior proven by VIRO-0005 becomes part of the standing baseline and future exporter changes are measured against real artifacts, with the export report expanded to cover every claimed classification.

VIRO-0016.title: Accessibility and keyboard audit of editor chrome with proven-defect fixes
VIRO-0016.outcome: Core editor journeys (new/open/save, undo/redo, tool switching, zoom, panel navigation) are fully operable by keyboard and by screen-reader-meaningful labels: an audited findings report is committed, every proven accessibility defect found in existing chrome is fixed in place, and no layout or visual redesign is introduced.

VIRO-0017.title: UI visual-polish defect sweep against the AAA brief without layout invention
VIRO-0017.outcome: Existing UI surfaces conform to the GOVERNOR.md UX rules (panel tokens #2B2B2B/#323232, pasteboard #1F1F1F, copper accent #E07A2F only on active tool/selection, Segoe UI, radius 0-2px, honest empty states, distinct semantic icons): every measured deviation from the token spec is corrected in place with no new layout, no new components, and no descriptive prose.

VIRO-0019.title: Orchestrator identity hardening: bound claims to machine/session evidence
VIRO-0019.outcome: The shared control plane records and validates richer worker identity (stable worker ID + machine + session token) so two workers cannot accidentally operate under the same identity, stale-lease recovery becomes faster and safer, and the lease/state-machine logic in orchestrator-core is protected by its own unit tests.

VIRO-0140.title: Layer integrity: fix group duplication childless-shell and deep-delete dangling-parent corruption
VIRO-0140.outcome: Duplicating a group produces a complete independent copy (children included) with exact undo/redo; deleting a group of any depth leaves zero layers with dangling parentId; a document already carrying dangling parent links is repaired on open to visually-stable page-space positions; validateDocument stays clean through all three flows.

VIRO-0141.title: Post-boolean contour node editing commands + appendNode corruption guard
VIRO-0141.outcome: Boolean-result vectors (contours-authoritative) become editable at the node level through contour-addressed bus commands (move/insert/delete node, close contour), and the legacy appendNode path refuses to corrupt contours-authoritative layers, with derived inverses so every operation undoes exactly.

VIRO-0142.title: Render the v4 rich-text contract: per-range character and paragraph styling becomes visible
VIRO-0142.outcome: A v6 text story carrying CharacterRun/ParagraphRun ranges (authored via the existing type.characterRange / type.paragraphRange bus commands) renders with visibly distinct, correctly shaped per-run font/size/fill/tracking and per-paragraph alignment/indent on canvas and thumbnails, with stable undo/redo and save/reopen, while stories with empty runs render byte-identically to today.

VIRO-0143.title: Consume TextFrameProperties: insets, vertical align, auto-size in the type engine
VIRO-0143.outcome: Text frames honor their validated textFrame contract: insets shrink the measure, verticalAlign positions the composed block, autoSize grows the frame to fit content, and single-column zero-inset frames render pixel-identically to today.

VIRO-0144.title: Caret/selection fidelity from HarfBuzz clusters + inert script/direction fields
VIRO-0144.outcome: Caret stops derive from HarfBuzz cluster boundaries so carets and selection highlights land correctly under kerning and ligatures; story script/direction/language feed HarfBuzz instead of guessSegmentProperties; per-line compose stops re-shaping every prefix.
